# Copilot Instructions

- Scope: Hybrid crypto bot with FastAPI backend and React/Vite frontend. Backend covers Tokocrypto trading via ccxt, Solana swaps via Jupiter, paper trading, backtesting, fee/risk calculators, and system logs.
- Runtime basics: Backend expects `.env` in /backend (BOT_MODE defaults to PAPER). Start with `uvicorn main:app --reload` from /backend after installing `pip install -r requirements.txt`. Frontend lives in /frontend; run `npm install && npm run dev`.
- Data stores: SQLite DB file `crypto_bot.db` created by `python -c "import database; database.init_db()"` (tables defined in [backend/database.py](backend/database.py)). Paper and Solana state persist in JSON files (`paper_trading_state.json`, `solana_trades.json`, `solana_positions.json`).
- Modes & safety: BOT_MODE env selects LIVE/PAPER/BACKTEST; dashboard fetches `/api/bot/mode`. Risk limits come from env (MAX_POSITION_SIZE_PCT, MAX_PORTFOLIO_DRAWDOWN_PCT, MAX_DAILY_LOSS_PCT, MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS, RISK_PER_TRADE_PCT) and are enforced through [backend/risk_manager.py](backend/risk_manager.py) for paper trades and sizing APIs.
- Tokocrypto hunter loop: [backend/main.py](backend/main.py) defines `auto_trading_loop()` using ccxt async fetches to scan liquid USDT pairs, save trades to SQLite, and manage TP/SL + strategy votes from [backend/strategy.py](backend/strategy.py). It runs as a FastAPI background task toggled via `/api/bot/toggle` and status `/api/bot/status`.
- Strategy signals: `analyze_market()` in [backend/strategy.py](backend/strategy.py) calculates RSI/MACD/Bollinger on 1m OHLCV (async ccxt). Keep this async and reuse the existing indicator helpers.
- Market regime manager: `strategy.decide_strategy` picks a regime using ADX + BB width (squeeze). It selects EMA crossover (trend following), RSI mean-reversion (sideways), or BB breakout when bands are tight. `analyze_market` now includes ADX/BB width and the manager output in `indicators` and can override the action when a regime-specific signal exists.
- Backtesting: [backend/backtesting.py](backend/backtesting.py) runs offline simulations over ccxt historical candles with slippage/fees. Exposed via `/api/backtest/run`, `/api/backtest/batch`, history `/api/backtest/history` (saved with `database.save_backtest_result`).
- Paper trading: [backend/paper_trading.py](backend/paper_trading.py) holds virtual account state, slippage/fees, and tracks orders/trades. API endpoints: `/api/paper/account`, `/api/paper/buy`, `/api/paper/sell`, `/api/paper/reset`, `/api/paper/orders`, `/api/paper/trades`. Risk checks call `risk_manager.can_open_position()` before buys.
- Fee calculator: [backend/fee_calculator.py](backend/fee_calculator.py) models maker/taker + slippage; served via `/api/fee/calculate-buy`, `/api/fee/calculate-sell`, `/api/fee/round-trip`, `/api/fee/profit-target`. Frontend Fee tab expects these shapes.
- Risk tools: `/api/risk/position-size`, `/api/risk/summary`, `/api/risk/kelly` expose sizing, summary, and Kelly outputs. `RiskManager.get_risk_summary` needs current equity computed from paper positions.
- Solana/Jupiter: [backend/jupiter_handler.py](backend/jupiter_handler.py) wraps Jupiter quote/swap (IS_SIMULATION toggles dry-run). Requires SOLANA_RPC_URL, SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY, JUPITER_API_KEY. Balances via raw RPC `getTokenAccountsByOwner` to avoid library issues. Swaps logged through [backend/solana_tracker.py](backend/solana_tracker.py).
- Solana auto bot: [backend/solana_auto.py](backend/solana_auto.py) loops every 5s, optionally uses [backend/solana_scanner.py](backend/solana_scanner.py) to find pairs from Dexscreener, writes current position to `solana_positions.json`, and toggles via `/api/solana/auto/toggle` & `/api/solana/auto/status`. Manual swap endpoints: `/api/solana/quote`, `/api/solana/swap`; balances `/api/solana/balance`; history `/api/solana/history`.
- Logging: [backend/sys_logger.py](backend/sys_logger.py) buffers the last 50 log strings; frontend Live Terminal polls `/api/system/logs`. Avoid long noisy logs.
- Frontend wiring: [frontend/src/App.jsx](frontend/src/App.jsx) polls backend every 2s for status, balances, auto-bot status, history, and system logs. Tabs:
  - Dashboard ([frontend/src/components/DashboardTab.jsx](frontend/src/components/DashboardTab.jsx)) expects `/api/bot/mode`, `/api/risk/summary`, `/api/paper/account`.
  - Backtesting tab uses `/api/backtest/run` and `/api/backtest/history` and renders `trades` array.
  - Paper Trading tab uses `/api/paper/*` plus `/api/toko/price/{symbol}` for quotes.
  - Risk tab calls risk endpoints; Fee tab calls fee endpoints.
- API host assumptions: frontend calls `http://127.0.0.1:8000/...` directly. Keep CORS open (already configured in [backend/main.py](backend/main.py)).
- External keys & pitfalls: Tokocrypto ccxt uses TOKO_API_KEY/TOKO_SECRET_KEY. Solana private key must be base58. When IS_SIMULATION=TRUE, swaps are mocked but quotes still hit Jupiter. Ensure `exchange.close()` is awaited when loops stop.
- Persistence caveats: SQLite tables are not auto-initialized; run `database.init_db()` once. JSON stores are simple append/overwrite; keep writes small to avoid blocking the event loop.
- Testing: Only lightweight safety test present ([backend/test_safety_features.py](backend/test_safety_features.py) if added later). Prefer writing FastAPI endpoint tests with httpx/pytest; no harness exists yet.
- Style conventions: backend uses async for I/O (ccxt, aiohttp, FastAPI handlers). Keep new endpoints async when hitting network; reuse existing helpers (risk manager, fee calculator) instead of duplicating math. Frontend uses inline styles and axios; maintain response shapes to avoid breaking tabs.
